faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about comparing football tickets on Seatigo.

items.a: No. Seatigo compares ticket offers from third-party sellers — you complete your purchase securely on the seller's own website.

items.q: How does Seatigo find the lowest price?
items.a: We pull live offers from every connected seller for a match, normalize them, and show you the lowest price and full seller list side by side.
We only compare offers from established ticket sellers and box offices. Always review the seller's own terms before you buy.

items.q: Why do prices change so quickly?
items.a: Ticket prices and availability are set by each seller and can change at any time — we refresh offers frequently so you're comparing current prices.

about.title: About Seatigo
about.body: Seatigo compares football ticket offers from trusted sellers across Europe's biggest leagues and cups. We help fans find the match, compare sellers and choose the deal that works for them — every purchase is completed on the seller's own website.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: Have a question about an order or a partnership enquiry? Reach us anytime at support@seatigo.com and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.body: Find quick answers about browsing matches, choosing seats and how checkout works. If you can't find what you're looking for, our support team is happy to help.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.body: These terms govern your use of Seatigo. By browsing matches or clicking through to a seller, you agree to the terms outlined here. A full legal version will be published before launch.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: We only collect the information needed to run your ticket search and show relevant offers, and we never sell your data. A complete privacy policy will be published before launch.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.body: Seatigo uses a small number of cookies to remember your language and keep the site working smoothly. A full cookie policy will be published before launch.
